description: The OODA loop is a decision-making process developed by US Air Force Colonel, John Boyd. It stands for observe, orient, decide, and act and is also known as the Boyd Cycle. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the environment and being able to make decisions quickly in order to gain an advantage over opponents.
